verses.en: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph.
O God, keep not Thou silence; Hold not Thy peace, and be not still, O God.

verses.he: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.en: For, lo, Thine enemies are in an uproar; And they that hate Thee have lifted up the head.
They hold crafty converse against Thy people, And take counsel against Thy treasured ones.

verses.he: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגּ֑וֹי וְלֹֽא־יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד׃
verses.en: They have said: 'Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.'

verses.he: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃
verses.en: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against Thee do they make a covenant;
The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

verses.he: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.he: גַּם־אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤י֥וּ זְר֖וֹעַ לִבְנֵי־ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Assyria also is joined with them; They have been an arm to the children of Lot. Selah

verses.he: עֲשֵֽׂה־לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִֽיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃
verses.en: Do Thou unto them as unto Midian; As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook Kishon;
Who were destroyed at En-dor; They became as dung for the earth.

verses.he: שִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כָּל־נְסִיכֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, And like Zebah and Zalmunna all their princes;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: Who said: 'Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.'
O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.
As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains ablaze;
So pursue them with Thy tempest, And affright them with Thy storm.

verses.he: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִֽיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; That they may seek Thy name, O LORD.
Let them be ashamed and affrighted for ever; Yea, let them be abashed and perish;

verses.he: וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: That they may know that it is Thou alone whose name is the LORD, The Most High over all the earth.
